notes: New kind LoginAlertStack (src/kit/custom/), built for Claude Concept A. Toast texts are illustrative UI labels, not data. The alert lands on "suspicious logins" (about 1.1 s into the line).

coverage.item: enter: two neutral toasts with a green dot slide down one after the other, fading in and de-blurring
coverage.how: calmPose: 0.34 s outCubic slide from -26 px, blur 7 -> 0, 0.25 s stagger

coverage.item: move: the red 'Suspicious sign-in' toast drops in on top on "suspicious logins" and pushes the stack down
coverage.how: alertPose.push moves the calm toasts down by one toast height; alertAt 1.1 s

coverage.item: move: the red rim pulses once
coverage.how: one 0.7 s sine glow on the red rim after landing

coverage.item: move: a FLAGGED tag stamps in with a small scale pop
coverage.how: tag scales 1.45 -> 1 and fades in 0.42 s after the drop

coverage.item: exit: the whole stack slides up a little and fades out together at the end of the line
coverage.how: shared exit at outAt 3.2 s: -18 px and fade over 0.3 s; ends at 7.70 s

coverage.item: placement: lower UI band beside the speaker, face never covered
coverage.how: centred at 70% of the height (UI band 58-85%)

coverage.item: style: dark-glass toasts as in ONS-041
coverage.how: kit dark-glass surface, hairline border, status dots

coverage.item: sound: soft UI tick per neutral toast, sharper alert click on the red toast
coverage.how: sound intents 'toasts' and 'alert' become SFX items on the SFX track; the sound library is empty, so they have no sound asset yet (shown as missing)
